manage.title: Manage notices
manage.hint: Drafts, publishing now or later, and withdrawing. Withdrawn notices stay on record.

form.bodyHint: Links are shown as text and cannot be clicked.
form.targetsLabel: Only some classes or sections (guardians only)
form.targetsHint: Leave empty for every guardian. Staff see every notice meant for them.
form.expiresHint: It leaves the board at the end of this day.
form.pinnedLabel: Pin to the top of the board
form.editedWarning: Changing a published notice marks it "edited" for everyone.

publishDialog.title: Publish notice
publishDialog.hint: Up to 30 days ahead. It appears on the board by itself when the time comes.

withdrawDialog.title: Withdraw notice
withdrawDialog.text: It leaves everyone's board and stays on record. It cannot be edited afterwards.

errors.TARGET_INVALID: A chosen class or section is not valid. Staff notices take no classes.
errors.EXPIRY_INVALID: The end date must be after the notice is published.
errors.SCHEDULE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Choose now or a time within 30 days.
errors.NOT_EDITABLE: This notice can no longer be changed.
